The area between the player and the structure is cleared of all natural terrain features (trees, leaves) to ensure unobstructed access. The structure consists of four acacia plank walls (7 blocks wide, 5 blocks deep, 3 blocks tall) with a hollow interior and a single acacia door in the center of the front (south-facing) wall.
task_text: Mine the acacia door on the structure ahead of you.
design_notes: First two commands clear the area of natural terrain (trees/leaves) and lay a flat grass floor. Next four /fill commands create the four walls of the structure. The /fill air command hollows out the interior. The two /setblock commands place the lower and upper halves of the acacia door facing south toward the player. The door is at relative position (0, 1, 6) — directly ahead of spawn, 6 blocks away at ground level. The player can walk straight forward and punch the door to break it. No tools are required.
